name: Binocular
scope: Daily scouting edition. Recommendations are analyst judgments checked against saved ownership; confirm injuries and game locks in Sleeper before acting.

sleeper.title: Sleeper API documentation
sleeper.finding: Read-only league data. Trending counts measure adds; player metadata is cached daily. Display week can differ from NFL week.

qb.title: ClutchPoints · Week 2 QB rankings
qb.finding: Ranks Caleb Williams 7th, Bo Nix 10th, Patrick Mahomes 17th and Baker Mayfield 20th. These are ordinal opinions, not projections for your custom scoring.

flex.title: Pat Fitzmaurice · Week 2 PPR flex
flex.finding: The checked PPR list places Etienne ahead of Godwin and Reed. Weekly rankings remain opinions, not custom-scoring projections.

wr.title: Pat Fitzmaurice · Week 2 PPR receivers
wr.finding: Adams is WR23, Golden WR35 and Reed WR45 in this ranking. This supports Adams over Reed without treating a single list as certainty.

ladd.title: Chargers · McConkey injury update
ladd.finding: Jim Harbaugh described McConkey as day-to-day with a rib injury. That is not clearance to play in Week 2.

douglas.title: DraftKings Network · Caleb Douglas usage
douglas.finding: Douglas played 91% of snaps and drew seven targets, catching five for 94 yards. Malik Washington drew eight targets; adding Douglas does not automatically make Washington expendable.

black.title: 49ers · Week 1 game recap
black.finding: Kaelon Black had 14 carries for 65 yards. Meaningful involvement makes him a bench candidate; one game does not establish a weekly starting workload.

loveland.title: DraftKings Network · Loveland vs. Kmet
loveland.finding: Loveland had an 87% snap share and 35 routes despite no receptions. Kmet ran 19 routes. Opportunity supports holding Loveland rather than chasing the Week 1 touchdown.

golden.title: DraftKings Network · Matthew Golden role
golden.finding: Golden recorded 12 targets and 40 routes with an 82% snap share. Keep the upside, while allowing for Week 1 game-script inflation.

coker.title: Panthers · Coker’s Week 1 performance
coker.finding: Coker produced 138 receiving yards and two touchdowns. His availability deserves attention even when a trending-only shortlist misses him.

coker_health.title: Panthers · Coker ankle update
coker_health.finding: Coker wore a precautionary boot after rolling his ankle. He expected not to miss time, but the weekly practice and game-status reports remain necessary.

dst.title: FantasyPros · Week 2 defense streamers
dst.finding: Ranks Tampa Bay 1st, Philadelphia 2nd, San Francisco 4th, Denver 8th and Minnesota 21st. Generic projected points are not recalculated for your leagues.

value.title: FantasyPros · Week 2 redraft trade values
value.finding: Use as a rough negotiation check, not an acceptance probability. The chart separates 1QB and 2QB values; package totals alone do not prove a trade is fair.

pfn.title: PFSN · Week 2 waiver analysis
pfn.finding: Vele benefits from Tyson’s absence. Allgeier’s early role complicates Love’s workload. These are role-sensitive situations, not guaranteed weekly production.

apple.title: Apple · Sidebar guidance
apple.finding: Keep navigation shallow and let people hide the sidebar to make room for content.

access.title: Apple · Accessibility guidance
access.finding: Support legible text, adequate contrast, keyboard interaction and status labels that do not depend on color alone.

product.title: FantasyPros · My Playbook
product.finding: League-aware lineup, waiver and trade tools are a useful reference. Binocular should expose the evidence and roster cost behind a proposed move.

katz.title: Jason Katz · Week 2 quarterback rankings
katz.finding: Favors Daniels and Hurts over Purdy, Nix over Mahomes, and Caleb Williams over Mayfield. Not a custom-scoring projection.

bowers_update.title: Las Vegas Review-Journal · Bowers update
bowers_update.finding: Klint Kubiak described Bowers as day-to-day. This does not establish Week 2 availability; Sleeper still lists him Out in the saved roster.

practice.title: Raiders · Wednesday Week 2 injury report
practice.finding: Bowers (knee) and McConkey (rib) did not practice Wednesday. Neither has a final Week 2 game designation on this report.

texans.title: Texans · Week 2 injury report
texans.finding: Collins was limited Wednesday with a hamstring injury. A final game status is still needed.

saints.title: Saints · Wednesday injury report
saints.finding: Juwan Johnson missed Wednesday practice with an illness.

swift.title: FantasyPros · Swift practice update
swift.finding: Swift was limited Wednesday with ankle and knee issues; this is not a final game designation.

bills.title: Bills · Final Thursday injury report
bills.finding: The final report lists Cole Bishop, Ty Johnson and T.J. Sanders as questionable. Check the inactive list before kickoff.
